_about: The welcome every new person sees once (qtt_platform.api.setup.welcome): what QTT OS does for them, by app and by role. "for" uses the screens.json role words (product roles, @owner, @manager); no "for" = everyone with the app. Translated in the app (tool/extract_strings.py).

intro.title: Welcome to QTT OS
intro.body: One app for your work — your team, your shop, your customer chats and your website. Here's what it does for you.

lines.text: Check in with one tap — at the office, or with a reason when you're away
Apply for leave and see how many days you have left
Claim expenses with a photo of the receipt
Your payslip every month, ready to save
Approve your team's leave, expenses and attendance in one place
See who's in, late or on leave today
Shifts, rotations, holidays and leave — set up once, then it runs by itself
Payroll with attendance, unpaid leave and overtime counted for you
Bill at the counter — cash, UPI or card, even split two ways
GST worked out on every bill
See what's in stock as you sell
Who owes you, what's running low and today's sales — at a glance
Purchases, accounts and GST reports
WhatsApp, website chat, Facebook, Instagram and email — in one inbox
Reply, add private notes and take chats for yourself
Share chats across the team and see every inbox
Connect your channels in a few taps

QTT_SERVICES.title: Managed Services — done for you by QTT

lines.text: Follow your website, online store and automations — live status, previews and progress
Ask QTT for a change, any time
Order a website, an online store or WhatsApp automation — QTT builds and runs it
Approve previews and pay invoices here

everyday.title: Ask QTT anything
everyday.body: The ✦ button on every screen answers questions about that screen — what to do first and how things work — in your language.

everyday.title: What needs you, on Home
everyday.body: Cards on Home show what needs you now. Search finds people, customers, items and screens — even with a typo.

everyday.title: Your business
everyday.body: Invite your team, choose what each role can do and see your plans — under Business.

more.title: More from QTT
more.body: Add another app whenever your business needs it — they all share your team and customers.
